purpose: Evidence for a separately approved supervised live pilot, not a profitability certification
activation_requires: Critical safety and account-contract gates passed
Complete cost and comparable total-return reporting
Explicit operator approval of a frozen paper observation manifest

window.start: First full broker-calendar regular session after activation requirements pass; record before collecting outcomes
window.end: Later of session 60 close and first session close at or after 12 calendar weeks
window.safety_stop: Immediate pause on invariant breach; retain all outcomes and costs; stopped study cannot pass

minimum_information.insufficient_sample: INCONCLUSIVE; no forced trades, automatic extension or retrospective window selection

secondary: Uninvested cash using actual broker cash interest, zero only if verified
requirements: Same observation window and external-flow schedule
Common currency and declared dividend/withholding treatment
Aligned regular-session close and dated source provenance
Include simulated execution fees/slippage for investable baselines
No comparison of portfolio total return with benchmark price return

metrics: Flow-adjusted total return before operating costs
Return after all allocated model/data/infrastructure costs
Primary and secondary benchmark excess return
Maximum drawdown and daily return series
Decision completion and independently reviewed claim support
All attempts cost and latency including failures
Fill/reject/cancel rates and observed execution shortfall
Operational incidents and time to detection/recovery

acceptance.safety: Zero unexplained broker/ledger divergence, duplicate submissions, unauthorized exposure or guard bypasses; every incident reviewed
acceptance.research: At least 90 percent completion on predeclared sufficient-evidence cases; no materially unsupported BUY/ADD; independent review of every actionable decision
acceptance.data: No missing required sessions, unresolved charges or unmatched cost allocation; noncomparable baselines block acceptance
acceptance.performance: Positive after-cost excess return over the primary benchmark is necessary but insufficient; dependence-aware uncertainty and independent economic review required. Interval spanning zero cannot substantiate positive edge
acceptance.decision: GO requires all engineering/account gates, adequate sample and independent review; otherwise NO-GO or INCONCLUSIVE. No automatic live promotion

analysis.uncertainty: Report primary excess-return uncertainty using paired daily observations and 5-session block resampling, 10000 resamples, seed 1648; sensitivity at 10-session blocks. Treat small-sample/regime limits explicitly; do not infer independence from trade count
analysis.secondary_metrics: Descriptive only; do not substitute a better-performing secondary benchmark for primary
analysis.exclusions: None after activation: failures, downtime, abstentions and costs remain in denominators
analysis.existing_holdings: Include existing paper holdings at opening broker marks and disclose legacy origin; separately describe new decisions without excluding legacy P/L from the portfolio
analysis.changes: Retain predecessor study; a material code/prompt/model/config/universe change starts a new preregistered candidate window, not a relabeled continuation
analysis.budget: Existing authorized daily/run caps apply; insufficient budget delays activation or yields inconclusive observations, not permission to spend more
